{{recipesummary | category = Side dish recipes | servings = 1 | time = Prep: 20 minutes
Cook: 30–40 minutes | difficulty = 2 | Image = [[File:Cauliflower cheese side dish.jpg|300px]] }} {{nutritionsummary|1 recipe (750 g)|1|1028|730|81.1 g|52.6 g|415 mg|6408 mg|43.2 g|4.25 g|24.1 g|31.2 g|14%|151%|96%|11%}} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Side dishes|Side dishes]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United Kingdom|British cuisine]] '''Cauliflower cheese''' or '''cauliflower gratin''' (French: ''Choufleur au Gratin'') is a filling and cheesy dish, great as a side to a [[Cookbook:Roast Dinner|roast dinner]] or any other dish.Beeton, I. (1907). [https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Page%3AMrs_Beeton's_Book_of_Household_Management.djvu/936 Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management] {{Beeton}} == Ingredients == * 1 large [[Cookbook:Cauliflower|cauliflower]] head * 300 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (10 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 1 ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]]) [[Cookbook:White Sauce|white sauce]] * 100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (3.5 oz) [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|parmesan]] * 30 g (1.1 oz) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]] * 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] * 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] == Procedure == # Cut your cauliflower into small florets, and place them heads down into a bowl of salty water to dress them for an hour. # Drain florets, and add them to a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] of salted [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] water. Cook, uncovered, regularly checking the feel of the cauliflower with a knife to see when they are ready. Your knife should go smoothly, but with some firmness to the cauliflower still. # Preheat your [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 200°C (180°C fan/390°F/gas 6). # Once the cauliflower has cooked, drain the florets and lay them in a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|dish]] of your choice. Combine the white sauce with ⅔ of the parmesan cheese, and pour over the cauliflower. Sprinkle over the breadcrumbs and remaining cheese. # Place your dish into the oven for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown. # Serve immediately. == References == {{Reflist}} [[Category:Recipes using butter]] [[Category:Recipes using cauliflower]] [[Category:Recipes using parmesan]] [[Category:Recipes using bread crumb]]

steps.text: Cut your cauliflower into small florets, and place them heads down into a bowl of salty water to dress them for an hour.

Drain florets, and add them to a saucepan of salted boiling water. Cook, uncovered, regularly checking the feel of the cauliflower with a knife to see when they are ready. Your knife should go smoothly, but with some firmness to the cauliflower still.

Once the cauliflower has cooked, drain the florets and lay them in a dish of your choice. Combine the white sauce with ⅔ of the parmesan cheese, and pour over the cauliflower. Sprinkle over the breadcrumbs and remaining cheese.
Place your dish into the oven for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
